description: Use Claude Haiku 5.5 as the advisor your main model consults at decision points (before committing to an approach, on a recurring error, before declaring a task done). The cheapest advisor, for these main models: Haiku 4.5 or 5.5, Sonnet 4.6 or 5, and Opus 4.6. Claude Code does not attach it to Sonnet 5.5, Opus 4.7 or later, or Fable. Pinned to the full model ID. Requires Claude Code v2.1.293+ on the Anthropic API or v2.1.300+ on Claude Platform on AWS; on the Anthropic API, the advisor stays off when DISABLE_TELEMETRY or CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC is set.
